description: Prosumer Environment Smart Meter Energy Time Series: Power, Voltage and Frequency measurements with 1s time resolution - 1 month is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Valentin Boghirnea, Radu Plămănescu. "The dataset includes active power, voltage and frequency measurements for a residential prosumer located in Mogosoaia, Romania, collected at a 1 frame\/second reporting rate over 31 consecutive monthsWe hope that the dataset is useful to energy systems and computational intelligence researchers for energy transfer analysis, RES generation integration for residential applications, time series forecasting, classification ... Coverage: national (RO); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
